name: Red dunes at dusk
one_line: Rust dunes, two low suns and a huge pale planet.
look_words: A desert on another world at sunset, painted like the cover of an old science-fiction paperback. Dunes in rust, maroon and ochre with smooth airbrushed fades; a burnt-orange sky with two small low suns and a huge pale ringed planet. Shadows are long and deep maroon. Shapes are bold and smooth with clean edges and very little detail. Because the whole world is red and orange, harm is a vivid violet, and the things that matter are bright yellow and teal; the player is cream. Motion is wind and speed: sand streaming off dune crests, long dust trails, sails filling. Avoid green, grey, gritty realism, lens flares, and bloom on the suns.

palette.name: red dunes
palette.notes: In a red world, red cannot mean harm: violet does. The sun is very low, so shadows are long.
